newsitem.title: BURMA: Bangladeshi bank opens Burma's 43rd rep office.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshi bank opens Burma's 43rd rep office.

text.p: The National Bank of Bangladesh became the 43rd foreign bank to open a representative office in Burma, the official media reported on Wednesday.
Brigadier General Win Tin, the minister for finance and revenue, said the representative offices are part of a plan to liberalise the nation's banking sector.

"We are now embarking on the second stage of developing our banking industry by allowing the formation of joint venture banks," he said at the opening of the National Bank office, noting that several banks were in talks with prospective foreign partners.
